presets.name: Flat
presets.description: No extra colour: just your correction, or the earphones as they are.

presets.name: Warm
presets.description: A fuller low end and gently softened treble for relaxed listening.

presets.name: Bass boost
presets.description: More punch and weight, with the lower mids kept clean so voices stay clear.

presets.name: Deep bass (sub only)
presets.description: Adds rumble below about 60 Hz only, so kick drums deepen without muddying the mids.

presets.name: Bright & airy
presets.description: More sparkle and space on top, with a touch less bass for a lighter sound.

presets.name: Vocal clarity
presets.description: Brings singers and speech forward by trimming boom and lifting the presence range.

presets.name: Electronic & hip-hop
presets.description: Deep, tight bass and crisp highs, with a little less low-mid mud.

presets.name: Rock & metal
presets.description: Punchy drums and guitars that cut through, without boxy mids.

presets.name: Acoustic & jazz
presets.description: Natural body for instruments and a gentle, unforced top end.

presets.name: Treble tamer
presets.description: Calms harsh, tiring treble: a soft high-shelf cut plus a dip where cheap earphones often peak.

presets.name: De-ess
presets.description: Softens sharp "s" and "t" sounds in voices without dulling everything else.

presets.name: Small drivers rescue
presets.description: For tiny or very cheap drivers: drops the deepest bass they cannot play cleanly and adds punch and clarity where they can.

presets.name: Podcast / spoken word
presets.description: Clear, close voices: less rumble and boom, more articulation, no hiss.

presets.name: Movie night
presets.description: Bigger effects and clearer dialogue for films and shows.

presets.name: Gaming footsteps
presets.description: Turns down explosions and lifts the range where footsteps and reloads live.

presets.name: Late night
presets.description: Smooth and fatigue-free for long, quiet sessions: softer upper mids and treble, a hint of warmth.

presets.name: Loudness at low volume
presets.description: Ears hear less bass and treble when music is quiet; this puts some back at low volume.
